dimension_hop.description: Teleport the subject a short distance (10 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels). The destination must be within line of sight.

seeking_ray.description: Ray deals 4d6 electricity damage, ignores concealment and cover. Subsequent rays against the same target gain +4 attack bonus for 1 round.

arcane_turmoil.description: Dispels one spell on the target, and forces the target to make a Will save or lose its highest-level prepared spell or spell slot.

evards_menacing_tentacles.description: Grow 4 tentacles from your body. Each round as a free action, you can make grapple or attack checks against adjacent foes with these tentacles.

ray_of_deanimation.description: Ray deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (max 15d6) to constructs, bypassing hardness.

chimeric_curve.description: Creates an illusory duplicate that mirrors your movements, deflecting the next incoming attack or ray spell to target the duplicate.
